# AI Academy for Beginners

> UK-based AI training for small business owners and non-technical professionals. We help owners find the bottleneck holding their business back and use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and no-code automation) to clear it, in plain English, with no coding. Led by Sam Onigbanjo, Enterprise Nation Accredited AI Adviser. 50,000+ member community.

## Approach
- Jobs to Be Done: start with the job that is stuck in the business, then hire AI for that job.
- One bottleneck at a time, measured weekly on four numbers: offers sent, leads collected, calls booked, cash collected.

## Common small business bottlenecks (with sources)
- Winning customers and growing sales: top operational challenge (Federal Reserve Small Business Credit Survey, 2026 report).
- Admin: UK owners spend about 11 hours a week on admin and finance tasks, about six working days a month, against 3.6 days on selling (American Express and Small Business Saturday UK SME Barometer, 2026).
- Costs and cash: rising costs are the top financial challenge (Federal Reserve, 2026); 31% of UK small firms cite fixed costs, 18% volatile cash flow (Novuna Business Finance, 2025).
- Red tape: 26% (Novuna, 2025). Cost of skilled labour: 20% (Novuna, 2025).
- The owner as the bottleneck (practitioner observation).

## Plans
- The Bottleneck Clinic: £19 a month. 27 self-paced lessons, live monthly session, Template Vault, weekly scorecard. https://coaching.aiacademyforbeginners.com/revenue-1st-ai-community
- Core: £397 a month. All seven modules, 10,000-prompt library, monthly live group Q&A.
- Growth: £550 a month. Core plus bi-weekly coaching with Sam's team, voice AI agents, advanced marketing, certificate.
- Elite: £950 a month, by application. Growth plus a monthly 1-to-1 with Sam and a 90-day roadmap.
- Every plan: 30-day money-back guarantee after working through the first two modules. Teams of five or more: partnerships@aiacademyforbeginners.com. https://aiacademyforbeginners.com/plans/
